title: Krueng Nyang Peuhah Hate .
intro: Bayangkan saboh teuntra dalam pawai, deuek dan teu-uji, dipat saboh komando di binèh kruëng akan meupisah tekad nibak keuheundak. Sidroe peumimpén nyang geupiléh geubimbéng barisan u arah musoh nyang that teuga, geuba amanah keu Allah mantong.
clues: Ulôn geu angkèë lé Allah sibagoë peumimpin ateuëh Bani Israil lheuëh awaknjan djilakèë sidroë untôk djimeuprang bak djalan Gobnjan.
Lon geubri ilme dan tuboh nyang le that sibagoe tanda pemilihan lon, bah pih rakyat lon jipeutanya keukuasaan lon.
Lon beurangkat deungon pasukan dan lon peugah bak awaknyan bahwa Allah akan geu uji awaknyan deungon saboh krueng.
Lon peuingat bahwa soe mantong nyang jieb bebas dari nyan hana akan jeut keu lon, kecuali sidroe nyang jicok saboh jaroe.
Lon meulintas ngon padum-padum droe nyang teutap teuga, meuhadap ngon teuntra nyang jioh leubeh rayeuk jumlah jih.
Lon pimpin ureuëng-ureuëng njang peugah pakriban kayem saboh perusahaan ubit meu-atô saboh perusahaan rajek deungon izin Allah, sigohlom Jalut taloë.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Teungoh ji rhom lam apui nyang seujuk .
Meu-uji teuntra deungon kruëng sigohlom prang .
trial.answer: Meu-uji teuntra deungon kruëng sigohlom prang .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Transformasi jeut keu kera keu pelanggaran .
Keuhancoran lé saboh beureutoh nyang that teuga .
Keumeunangan deungon izin Allah dan Jalut geupoh maté lé Dawud .
Karam lam laot ngon tuan rumoh .
outcome.answer: Keumeunangan deungon izin Allah dan Jalut geupoh maté lé Dawud .

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
